notes.title: UPDATE NEWS 14 May 24 (Level Unlocks)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44062218/81b107cde9eac6fa033ad2cb2a35cae6a16dbbc2.png[/img]

[b]Hello Combat Medics[/b],

The last two weeks we have been working on adding a level system to combat medic where you start of at Level 1 only having access to the basic bandage and as you work your way through the ranks you can unlock more advanced medical items like the forceps and the morphine injector allowing you to treat further injuries of your fellow soldiers. At level 1 your medical chest might look like this below.

 see an example WIP.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44062218/9e9e97851d5749cfd0eedd7df57de3912c879c0b.png[/img]

With this we have also been fixing bugs and random issues that we have found on the way. As well as making the game feel better to play with some quility of life fixes.

[b]INJURIES PREVIEWS
[/b]

Your comrades can receive lots of different types of injuries and they will all require a different tool to fix or repair below are just some of the injury types in the game,

- Shrapnel Injuries
- Gunshot Wounds
- Missing Limbs
- Shock
- Broken Limbs

And just some of the items you can use to heal these injuries,
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44062218/4343c79b6a13f80a5d67273d8dd598c722dd36c5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44062218/0fe41e760b932b80e9ceed05730017d1c52e0356.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44062218/31b842d3cef2bca8fccdbdaf55649e83e534d000.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44062218/64d2a06560152069d52ac49c288c99adad1b8e6a.png[/img]

again

Thank you for wishlisting it lets us know that people are interested and we should give continue to commit our free time for this project.

And all the best from the Combat Medic Team,

Gav and Josh

notes.title: UPDATE NEWS 01 May 24 (HEALING SYSTEM)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44062218/81b107cde9eac6fa033ad2cb2a35cae6a16dbbc2.png[/img]

Combat medics we are pleased to announce that Combat Medic is still in development after a brief pause, and work is being made now on adding a working healing system where each soldier will be assigned an injury and you will need to use the correct medical item to heal the soldier,

 please see an example below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44062218/2e39ec3942e61e2f0889c0aeb6255c2315300a5e.png[/img]
wip

We did have a long pause and the reason for this was this game is just a passion project of my own and Josh, between us we have very limited coding and game building skills. I drew all the art assets not even being an artist and josh has coded together the game. During this we got ambitious and hit a roadblock, but wanting to see this game complete we decided to seek outside help with some coding issues.

We have also changed the game from love.2d a lua program to unity this helps the game run better in so many ways. 

With Combat Medic being a passion project i am very fussy (being a gamer all my life) with how i expect things to work and feel and i am happier now that its heading in the right direction but we still have a bit of work to do to make Combat Medic a game that is fun to play.

Thank you for wishlisting it lets us know that people are interested and we should give are spare time for this to be complete. 

And all the best from the Combat Medic Team,

Gav and Josh

notes.title: Inventory System
notes.content:
We are pleased to say that good progress is being made and we are now working on the Inventory system.

We have added a new in game screen shot so you can see what this looks like. But here is a better view below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44062218/39c822832a814f522e70992f4cb20f0e7016f643.png[/img]

We are continuing work on the inventory system before starting work on the Medical System as they work hand in hand with each other.

We will continue to update you on the progress of the game. 

Thank you and good luck Medics.

The Combat Medic Team
